# Refresh PR

`tailrocks-refresh-pr` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-refresh-pr)

Reconcile an open pull request's title and body against the current diff: drifted prose rewritten, accurate prose kept verbatim, template sections re-selected. Extended by .tailrocks/pr.md. Do not use to open or merge a PR.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-refresh-pr` …

Arguments: `[PR]`
